[#hash-backends-of-argon2id]
.Who implements `argon2id` (RFC 9106, one lane)
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]
|===

| `argon2id`

|===

The default backend of `argon2id` on each target follows the measured orders of doc/measurements.json, which this build of the guide does not have yet; until then, the order of `detail/ranking.hpp` applies.

The orders are measured over `hmac_sha2_256`, every backend linked; a backend the program does not link is skipped. A named profile, `WEBCPP_HASH_PROFILE_BACKEND_<NAME>`, or an override, `WEBCPP_HASH_DEFAULT_BACKEND_ARGON2ID_<NAME>`, takes its backend where it has the function (<<hash-profile>>).
